dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge forming a smooth parabolic curve inward from the posterior base toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Atypical truncated horizontal apex with rounded transitional corners rather than a single acute point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear steep incline of approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the horizontal ventral boundary.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base length to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.25:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple diffused light-toned depigmentation patches across the lateral surface; structural truncation/flattening of the dorsal apex.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal fin exhibits a distinct plateau-like top surface instead of a standard tapered apex.
